points.label: Northern McMillan Lake basin
points.identity_evidence: Distinct three northern arms on the upper of the McMillan basins, southwest of McIntyre Lake and north of the lower McMillan complex. Both historical and modern outlines have the long central northern arm and two flanking arms. Whole outer basin centroid; modern internal island excluded from outer-boundary computation. Southern lakes are separate features.

points.label: White Lake outer basin
points.identity_evidence: Elongated White Lake south of McMillan lakes, north of the hachured hill and west of the north-south road/White Brook. Narrow southeastern arm and eastern neck distinguish this from neighbouring basins. Tributaries excluded; no coordinate taken from the WHITE LAKE label.

points.label: Pringle Lake outer basin
points.identity_evidence: Large two-lobed Pringle Lake east of the road, north of Rocky Lake and northeast of the small circular roadside pond. Source omits several modern islands and generalizes east/south inlets. Whole outer basin centroid retained with larger feature-definition uncertainty; no island or label centre used.
